en: Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` deny rules to also block that skill when Claude Desktop delivers it as a plugin, and `Skill(skill:<name>)` denies to match the skill's alias and display name
zh: `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` 拒绝规则现在也会在 Claude Desktop 将该 skill 作为 plugin 提供时阻止该 skill，`Skill(skill:<name>)` 拒绝规则现在会匹配 skill 的别名和显示名称
